name: Authorized admin opens and safely cancels a Google Sheets edit
description: Checks an authorized admin can open the form for an existing sheet record, see protected fields, and cancel without changing the sheet.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Wait until Google Sheets data is loaded
Open the edit form for a visible record
Confirm the record identifier is read only
Cancel the form without saving
expected: The edit form shows the selected record and read-only identifier; cancel closes the form and leaves the source data unchanged.

name: Google Sheets access failure shows the failing stage
description: Checks a failed source connection identifies whether authentication, API access, or schema validation failed without exposing secrets.
steps: Sign in while Google Sheets access is unavailable
Wait for the data request and connection status to settle
expected: The app distinguishes a connection or credential failure from a header mismatch and does not show Sandbox records.

name: Spreadsheet headers and tabs remain compatible
covers: customer, case, contact, task, document navigation
description: Checks the expected Google Sheet tabs and their schema are recognized by the application.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Open each of the five data tabs
Confirm each tab loads its matching table or displays a clear source error
expected: Each tab uses its Google Sheets data and no tab is silently populated from another source.

name: Customer name opens a read-only company profile
description: Verifies an authorized user can open the full registry details from a company name without changing the source.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Wait until Google Sheets data is loaded
Open the customer register and click a visible company name
Confirm the profile shows the customer ID and every registry field
Close the profile without saving
expected: A read-only popup shows every customer field for the selected company, including empty fields as dashes, then closes without writing to Google Sheets.

name: Draft company name controls the Google Search link
description: Checks the customer edit header uses the current synthetic company name for Google Search while preserving editable form values.
steps: Use only an isolated synthetic-data test app containing SYN-CUST-001, not production customer records
Sign in with the authorized test account and open the edit form for SYN-CUST-001
Change the company name to บริษัท ทดสอบ เอสเอ็มอี จำกัด without saving
Inspect the header link without following it: its Google query must match the trimmed name, its target must be _blank and its rel must contain noopener noreferrer
Change the name to บริษัท ทดสอบ A&B จำกัด and confirm the link query updates without changing the input or closing the form
Clear the company name and confirm the search link is hidden
Cancel without saving
expected: Only the customer edit header has the Google Search link; it follows the current Thai draft name, safely encodes special characters, hides when blank and never writes data during this test.
